task.description: Write test spec and unit tests covering the ISS-0074 fix.

result.summary: tests/specs/ISS-0074-fix.md written with 10 test cases (TC-ISS-0074-01..10). tests/unit/crypto_iss0074_test.zig implements 9 as runtime tests (TC-10 is a static code-review note, documented as such in the spec, not a runtime assertion). Wired into build.zig as `test-crypto-iss0074` step and added as a dependency of the default `test` step. All pure unit tests, no BPM_TEST_DB_URL dependency. No error.SkipZigTest used.
